how: Same cells as run 1 on the long window with column seg = long / fresh (2018-04..2021-12) / old (2022-24); per-cell run 1 vs long table in RESULT_LONG.md; Holm m = 48 / 192.
window: DEV 2018-04-01..2024-06-30 BTCUSDT SPOT klines (native 15m / 30m / 1h / 1d, not spliced with futures); VALIDATION not read (no DEV survivor); HOLDOUT never loaded

verdict.label: INCONCLUSIVE (underpowered), not FAIL and not PASS. On the long SPOT DEV window (2018-04-01..2024-06-30) the 48 pooled + 192 session cells (strict `with` gate + one OURS proxy arm, Holm m=48 / 192) produced 0 survivors, so VALIDATION stayed unread and HOLDOUT was never loaded. prereg_gate still BLOCKs every confluence cell (BLOCKED_LONG.md).

why: Lead 1 (15m sell RSI >= 60 below SMA200): run 1 +0.008 % was a 2022-24 feature; pooled n 651 net -0.183 % [-0.294, -0.072], fresh 2018-21 n 400 -0.305 %, old n 251 +0.011 %. Lead 2 (1h sell + divergence + retest): pooled n 46 -0.225 % [-1.058, +0.608], fresh n 27 -0.891 %. Neither lead holds out of the original window.

24 of 24 strict pooled cells have a negative long net. Proxy-bear buys are the only positive pooled cells (15m div n 75 +0.281 % [-0.036, +0.599], excess t 2.63), all Holm 1.00, mostly from the 2018 slice with tiny n: a hypothesis for a future pre-registered run, not a finding.
